events.title: Andy Cole becomes the first player to score five goals in a Premier League game in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 9–0 home win over 입스위치 타운 – which is also the biggest win yet in the Premier League. United now have a greater goal difference than 블랙번 로버스, who remain top by three points after a 1–0 away win over 애스턴 빌라. Fourth placed 리버풀 beat third placed 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 2–0 at Anfield.
웨스트햄 유나이티드 boost their survival hopes with 1–0 away win over local rivals 아스널.
맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the Premier League on goal difference when captain Steve Bruce scores the only goal of the game in an away win over 윔블던.
블랙번 로버스 return to the top of the Premier League with a 3–1 home win over 아스널.
애스턴 빌라 sign defender Alan Wright from 블랙번 로버스 for £1million.

리버풀's faint hopes of a unique domestic treble are ended when they lose 2–1 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the FA Cup quarter-final. 블랙번 로버스 drop two points but remain top of the Premier League when they draw 1–1 at Coventry, who ended their title hopes nearly a year ago. A Division One promotion crunch game at Burnden Park sees second-placed Bolton beat 미들즈브러 1–0, although both sides have two games in hand over leaders Tranmere.

에버턴's season which began with a 12-match winless start in the league is showing signs of turning into a success after they beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 1–0 at Goodison Park in the FA Cup quarter-final. 맨체스터 유나이티드 reach the semi-finals with a 2–0 win over 퀸스 파크 레인저스, managed by former United player Ray Wilkins and ending his hopes of beginning his managerial career with FA Cup glory.

첼시 captain Dennis Wise is sentenced to three months in prison for assault and criminal damage, but is released on bail pending an appeal against his conviction and sentence. The court case follows an alleged attack on a taxi driver in London.
리버풀's hopes of making a late run to the title are virtually ended when they lose 3–2 at home to 코번트리 시티, with Peter Ndlovu scoring a hat-trick for the Sky Blues.

블랙번 로버스 strengthen themselves for the title run-in with a £1.5million move for 사우샘프턴 defender Jeff Kenna . They are still three points ahead at the top of the Premier League after 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼 – the first time this season they have failed to score at home.

사우샘프턴 pay a club record £1.2million for 셰필드 웬즈데이 striker Gordon Watson to partner Matthew Le Tissier and Neil Shipperley in attack, with manager Alan Ball looking for fresh blood to lift his side out of the relegation zone.
맨체스터 유나이티드 are six points behind leaders 블랙번 로버스 after losing 2–0 to 리버풀 at Anfield with eight games remaining.

노리치 시티's 11-match winless run in the Premier League ends with a 3–0 win over local rivals 입스위치 타운 in the East Anglian derby at Carrow Road , and lifts John Deehan 's team five places into 11th position and pushes the visitors closer to an almost inevitable relegation.
리버풀 pay 밀월 £1.5million for 18-year-old Irish winger Mark Kennedy – a record fee in English football for a teenager.

크리스털 팰리스 reach the FA Cup semi finals for the time since 1990 with a 4–1 win at 울버햄프턴 원더러스 in the quarter-final replay. 맨체스터 유나이티드, who will be Palace's opponents in the semi-final at Villa Park next month, beat 아스널 3–0 at Old Trafford in the Premier League to keep their title hopes alive.

A judge at Croydon Crown Court sentences Eric Cantona to 14 days in prison for his attack on Matthew Simmons. He is released on bail, pending an appeal against the sentence. Meanwhile, Cantona's teammate Paul Ince faces charges relating to the incident, while Matthew Simmons will also face prosecution for allegedly provoking the attack.
Bryan Roy plays his last international match for the Netherlands national team , earning his 32nd cap against Malta.

Eric Cantona's prison sentence is quashed on appeal and he is sentenced to 120 hours of community service . Meanwhile, his 맨체스터 유나이티드 side are still second in the league to a 블랙번 로버스 team who have a three-point lead and a game in hand. The threat from 리버풀, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 노팅엄 포리스트 is now even more distant to the point that it could be mathematically ended within a couple of weeks. At the other end of the table, 입스위치 타운 and 레스터 시티 continue to prop up the rest of the Premier League and will now need a practical miracle to beat the drop. Meanwhile, 크리스털 팰리스 are sinking deeper and deeper into hot water, while 사우샘프턴 have fallen into the bottom four. A first win of 1995 has helped ease 노리치 시티's worries as they stand 12th, but they are just six points ahead of 19th-placed 사우샘프턴 who have two games in hand. 아스널, still reeling from the George Graham and Paul Merson scandals, are suddenly under surprise threat of relegation from a division they traditionally compete at the top end of. 미들즈브러 have regained their lead of Division One, where 볼턴 원더러스, 트랜미어 로버스, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and Reading complete the top five.
